purpose: Non-windowed verification of Rust stable-ID profile selectors, model reconciliation and captured native menu lifecycle; GUI acceptance deferred

build_input_snapshot.method: Committed staging/build/bootstrap archive plus four UI source overrides; concurrent network-policy edits excluded.
build_input_snapshot.python_scope: Current workspace suite includes two concurrent overlay/staging tests, excluded from this UI commit.

build_consistency: final Ninja dry run reported no work to do

deferred_gui_matrix.note: Matching backend and isolated browser fixture required. Compilation does not establish a pass.

unit_verified_mechanisms: Selected stable keys survive reorder and rename, including equal display labels; option lookup bounds and absent selection are explicit.
New-profile policy selects the last entry. Ordinary updates preserve ID; a removed ID uses first/last fallback policy, and empty models have no selection or popup admission.
Rust rejects empty/duplicate keys transactionally. Valid replacements cancel prior popup identity and prefix state, including numeric and captured-key commands.

Captured-key commands require current generation, visible/enabled admission supplied by native code and a present key. Same-value commands admit once and programmatic selection cancels stale commands.
Old close callbacks cannot collapse a new popup or reset a newer opening; valid close after accepted selection works once and invalidates subsequent dispatch.
Model updates reset prefix search, and normalized Unicode matching keeps stable identities distinct. Existing closed-control geometry/scene, source/import and form/input tests remain passing.
implemented_pending_runtime_verification: Workspace assignment and managed-profile selectors use SceneSelect/Rust state and two Metal closed-control canvases without native Combobox/Label/arrow/focus-ring/ink painting. Legacy Views retains its Combobox controls.

ProfileInfo IDs/names become UI key/label/search options; no profile objects, storage directories, imported data, credentials or WebContents enter Rust. Native profile CRUD/workspace persistence and browser-context isolation remain unchanged.

Rust reconciles stable selection and new-profile/removed-entry policies. Existing ProfileForm intent synchronizes managed selection. Workspace reopening restores the active workspace profile; Save/Create retains existing validation and service dispatch.

SceneSelectMenu owns each opening key snapshot and generation for enabled/activation/close callbacks. No callback consults a newer opening token or applies an old index to a replaced model. Import source uses the same hardened adapter.

Model replacement/programmatic selection cancels armed pointer/key input, prefix and popup state, updates optional selection/AX value and schedules Metal independently of native paint. Invalid test indices are rejected before opening Rust menu state.

Managed-profile user callback preserves confirmation/new-profile workspace reset, editor prefilling, Rust form selection and control/status refresh. Callback-free setters remain callback-free; activation test helpers explicitly dispatch for either backend.
Native popup/IME/AX/focus/event, font/color/metric protocols and existing shared Metal context remain. Closed controls reuse existing Rust recipe, GPU primitives and native fallback.

Nine existing browser-test expressions now use common View/optional selection/count or explicit callback-free setters. New compiled case checks both selectors, no native Combobox/Labels, AX value, reopen reset, create/rename selection, delete-confirmation cancellation, prefix/name prefilling, disabled actions, model capture cancellation and hide/reopen. It has not run.
deferred_checkpoint: Run 70 Metal cases and 34 Views controls, retaining DynamicProfiles, DynamicWorkspacesAndProfiles, WorkspaceDotProfileMenu, FailedConfigurationWritePreservesProfiles, profile-form validation/deletion and workspace profile-assignment regressions, plus import cases using the shared selector.

Exercise actual popup selection, same-value callback, Escape/cancel, old command/close versus model replacement/new popup, hidden/disabled/destruction lifetimes, keyboard, pointer/capture and focus return.
Verify committed Unicode input/IME and VoiceOver role/value/expanded state, editor prefilling, new-profile workspace intent, deletion-confirmation reset and disabled/programmatic behavior.
Verify profile create/rename/delete, removed-entry fallbacks, workspace Save/Create and persistence, profile/browser-context isolation and rollback with the actual native services.
Inspect Metal label/arrow rasterization and truncation, zero/narrow bounds, RTL/theme/scale, clipping/hover/focus/disabled styling and native fallback; package/sign matching isolated app.
Compare CPU/GPU/actual presentation separately. Unit duration, model admission and canvas count establish no end-to-end speedup.
limitations: No app or browser/desktop window was launched. Popup, native input/AX, rendering and profile/workspace persistence remain unaccepted.
Native popup/IME/Button/View/AX/focus/event and typography/color/metric adapters, editors/header/outer controls and other Views surfaces remain. Functional parity is incomplete.

No shader/quad ABI, crate, framework, icon asset or binary dependency was added. The CPU Rust/C++ selector bridge was extended for stable keys, optional-selection and model/menu lifecycle. Original Apache-2.0 code and upstream notices remain.
